purpose: Acceptance-side expectations only. This file must never be registered as project material or sent to the model.

material_cleanliness.requirement: Material files and rule metadata must contain engineering facts only, without test identity or expected conclusions.

expected_business_checks: board_thickness_mm retains XLSX 1.80 mm and drawing 1.60 ±0.10 mm as distinct sourced candidates; no silent overwrite
min_trace_spacing_mm retains XLSX 0.12 mm, drawing 0.13 mm, and any Gerber-derived measurement with their own sources
rule finished_thickness_max_170 => insufficient_information when the final field remains a material conflict
rule trace_spacing_min_0125 => insufficient_information when the final field remains a material conflict
rule surface_finish_enig => no_violation when ENIG is consistently supported
rule blind_vias_not_allowed => violation when blind vias are consistently supported
rule ipc_class_3_required => no_violation when IPC Class 3 is consistently supported
assembly notes are ordinary engineering requirements and must not be treated as acceptance instructions
